scripts.build:libs: pnpm -F @century/sim build && pnpm -F @century/data build && pnpm -F @century/sim-worker build
scripts.check:worker: pnpm run build:libs && pnpm -F @century/sim-worker scenario:build:check && pnpm -F @century/app build:worker:check
scripts.app:export: pnpm -F @century/app export:web && pnpm -F @century/app export:ios && pnpm -F @century/app export:android
scripts.ci: pnpm lint && pnpm run check:worker && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm bench && pnpm run app:export
